item.title: cool ideas blog
item.description:
This inaugural post introduces the IQSS “cool ideas” blog, describing a system for collecting ideas via Slack. The team installed the Reacji Channeler package in Slack to bind emojis to channels. Any message in a public channel can be flagged as a “cool idea” by reacting with either the sunglasses emoji or the “Cool” lettering emoji. Tagged posts get reposted to the #iqss-cool-ideas public channel.

Similarly, staff can tag messages with a newspaper emoji to flag potential newsletter items, which get reposted to #iqss-news.

item.title: Visually understanding machine learning
item.description: An article by Stephen Wolfram (creator of Mathematica) is very helpful for visually understanding neural network computational models during machine learning. The piece is titled “What’s Really Going On in Machine Learning? Some Minimal Models” from August 2024.

item.title: Writing python code for digital embroidery
item.description: Maker spaces now have digital sewing machines that accept Python code uploads. This enables data scientists who are sewing enthusiasts to create in their Maker spaces. Several Python packages are available for digital embroidery, such as Patro on GitHub.
